About the job:

As a Digital Marketing Executive at Ko Biotics Private Limited, you will be responsible for driving our online presence through various digital channels. If you have a passion for Social Media Marketing, SEO, Script Writing, Video Editing, Content Marketing, and Branding, then this is the perfect opportunity for you to showcase your skills and creativity. 



Key Responsibilities:

1. Create engaging and compelling content for our social media platforms to increase brand awareness and drive engagement.

2. Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve our website's visibility and drive organic traffic.

3. Write scripts for video content and work closely with the creative team to produce high-quality videos that resonate with our target audience.

4. Edit videos to ensure they are visually appealing and align with our brand identity.

5. Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns to promote our products and services.

6. Develop and implement content marketing strategies to attract and retain customers.

7. Manage and enhance our brand image through consistent messaging and visual identity across all digital platforms. 



If you are a creative and strategic thinker with a deep understanding of digital marketing trends, then we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of Ko Biotics Private Limited and take your career to new heights. Apply now and be part of our dynamic team!

jobs_results.title: Influencer Marketing Executive - Fresher
jobs_results.description:
About the job:

As an influencer marketing executive at Dtangle Media, you will be part of a fast-moving team that turns campaign plans into live, high-performing influencer content. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who is organised, communicates well, and enjoys working directly with creators.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Execute influencer campaigns end to end, from outreach to content going live, in line with the brief and timelines.

2. Source, shortlist, and reach out to influencers across regions, and negotiate rates and deliverables within the approved budget.

3. Coordinate with influencers daily on briefs, content requirements, shoot schedules, and posting dates.

4. Review and track content drafts, share feedback, and get approvals from the internal team and clients before posting.

5. Follow up with influencers to make sure deliverables are submitted on time and meet quality standards.

6. Maintain trackers for influencer databases, campaign schedules, deliverables, and payments.

7. Monitor live campaigns and compile performance data (reach, views, engagement, and other KPIs) for client reports.

8. Work with the creative team to share inputs and make sure content fits the brand and the regional audience.

9. Keep track of social media trends, platform updates, and competitor activity to support campaign execution.



If you enjoy building relationships with creators and getting campaigns delivered on time, we would love to hear from you. Join Dtangle Media and help shape the future of influencer marketing.

Good follow-up, coordination, and time-management skills3. Working knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, and other social platforms4. Comfort with spreadsheets and basic reporting5. Prior experience in influencer or social media marketing is a plus, but freshers with the right skills and attitude are welcome.

About Company:

Dtangle is a dynamic influencer marketing and creator management agency that helps brands grow through impactful digital campaigns. We specialize in connecting brands with the right creators across beauty, fashion, lifestyle, and regional niches. Our team manages complete campaign execution, creator sourcing, briefing, negotiations, content tracking, dispatch coordination, and final reporting, ensuring smooth operations and measurable results.



With a data-driven and ROI-focused approach, Dtangle delivers campaigns that are authentic, engaging, and aligned with brand objectives. We also support creators by providing high-quality collaboration opportunities and professional guidance to elevate their digital journeys.



Dtangle is committed to making influencer marketing seamless, transparent, and growth-oriented for both brands and creators.
